review.method: Version 2 corrects field semantics and citations after user source review, before the first agent run. Original version 1 evidence and expectations remain archived.
review.firm_attribution_note: The enforcement record names Frito-Lay, Inc. Headquarters; the FDA-hosted announcement is issued by The Quaker Oats Company. Product, size, printed UPC, code and initiation date agree. Preserve both firm names; use the notice issuer for instructions.
review.user_source_review: User independently checked the notice and confirmed its product, code, bounding sentence, purchase-availability date and consumer audience. This is not sign-off of every synthetic expected answer.

variant.code_semantics: The complete printed Code Date & Manufacturing Code, BBD SEP 13 25 P, on the top panel. The trailing P is required. The notice does not specify a separate lot code.

instructions.action: Do not consume the recalled product; discard it immediately.
instructions.trigger: The consumer has an allergy or sensitivity to milk AND has the recalled product.
